architecture_contract.warning: The repository exposes differing pretraining and evaluation configurations and no signed checkpoint-to-config manifest. Architecture, maximum lengths, masking, vocabulary order, and state-dict keys must be bound to the exact checkpoint before any load.

checkpoint.warning: The checkpoint is an executable pickle-format artifact. Its known hash does not authorize unrestricted torch.load. No acquisition or deserialization occurred in this audit.

input_and_query_contract.official_dataloader: PairedSCDataset over paired RNA and ATAC h5ad inputs
input_and_query_contract.randomness: Rows above maximum length are randomly subsampled in the released data path; RNA nonzero/zero sampling and permutations also require explicit worker-level seeds.
input_and_query_contract.warning: A deterministic tokenization and truncation policy, exact vocabulary/references, out-of-vocabulary semantics, and same-row pairing checks must be frozen. The ATAC-derived CLS vector must not be described as an RNA-conditioned prediction.

pretraining_contract.warning: Tissue and cell-count summaries do not establish exclusion of a target accession, donor, or release alias. The official MiniAtlas dataset card lists data files but no accession-level provenance crosswalk.

runtime_contract.warning: The official evaluation path assumes CUDA distributed execution with NCCL. No package environment was created and no compatibility claim is made.

safe_loading_contract.warning: The official scripts call unrestricted torch.load. That path is not benchmark-admissible for the upstream pickle.

source_evidence: The exact GitHub and Hugging Face revisions, checkpoint and companion artifact metadata, official code/config/data paths, MiniAtlas dataset card, environment declaration, and primary preprint were checked on 2026-08-22. No artifact was downloaded, installed, executed, or deserialized.

task_fit.development_only_candidate: Observed-ATAC cell representation and an explicitly directional paired-modality diagnostic after a separate nonpromotable TaskSpec, exact vocabulary/reference crosswalk, corpus audit, terms resolution, and safe conversion.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: ineligible because native inference consumes observed target ATAC tokens and the released direction is not RNA/context-only ATAC profile prediction
task_fit.sealed_cell_state_mapping: ineligible because GSE289173 exposes RNA-only nuclei while the CLS cell representation is ATAC-derived
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: ineligible because the model has no genomic sequence or REF/ALT allele-effect mechanism and does not emit signed eQTL/ieQTL effects
